body: MAINLINE-016 filed. The secondary rows at the MAINLINE-009 P2 point, every value QUESTIONABLE or PROJECTION; MAINLINE-012 was unfiled so its 1/T and pressure terms are derived here from the ideal-gas law. Vacuum holding: the 1 percent per day allowance is 48.894 kg of air, 954.6 Pa inside, 46.28 Pa m3/s, a 2.48 mm2 choked hole; face permeation is nil, outgassing 0.00-0.03 percent of budget, resident core moisture worth 347-2079 Pa if released, so bake-out is required; a 150-400 kg trim pump is 61-164 percent of the margin at 527-844 W, commissioning pump-down 506 kWh. Seams: 89.2-3004.3 kg across 4 m to 0.25 m panels against the 216.4 kg allowance; only PROJECTION 4 m SiC panels fit, today's 0.5 m plates are 330-694 percent, 0.25 m tiling leaves the hull 966-2543 kg heavy. Thermal: coated faces within 9 K of air, bare SiC +15 to +21 K by day, no-convection bound 313.5 K under the H35 343-353 K service limit; CTE mismatch shear-lag is 283 kPa per 30 K face-core swing, SF 1.41-1.94 against H35 shear, cycled daily, a mode outside the five scored. Loads: weather 3 percent moves the governing SF 0.228-0.243; gust 20 m/s is 0.24 percent of p_ext, 48.3 kN mooring, bare patch SF 0.73, 0.145 m2 spreaders. Climate: +25.1 K takes the margin to -186.3 kg; 0.1 mm retained water is 125.6 kg. Ranking: seams, climate and water, CTE cycling, pump, weather. The two most needing grounding: seam panel reality and the site climate envelope. Eleven NFI rows filed. The card names no successor job; the robotics seat sends the next.
